annotation.interpretation_a: The restriction applies to any packet protected by either 0-RTT or 1-RTT keys, meaning if *any* packet in the stream was protected by either, the ACK frame must be protected.
annotation.interpretation_b: The restriction applies only to packets *exclusively* protected by 0-RTT or 1-RTT keys, allowing an ACK frame to be unprotected if a packet was protected by a later, full session key.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'protected by 0-RTT or 1-RTT keys' is incomplete. It doesn't specify whether the restriction applies to packets that were *ever* protected by those keys, or only to packets that are *currently* protected. This leads to two reasonable interpretations of the requirement.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the protection requirement applies to any packet that *was* protected by 0-RTT/1-RTT, or only to packets *currently* protected by those keys.
